chunks: A number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from ʿAbdullāh ibn Baḥr, from Ibn Muskān, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I heard Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام saying:

The Imams are at the rank of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, except that they are not Prophets, and it is not permissible for them regarding women what was permissible for the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله. As for whatever is apart from that, then in it they are at the rank of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله.

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the rank of the Imams in relation to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the Imams occupy a rank analogous to that of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله in matters other than Prophethood and certain exclusive legal permissions. It affirms the exalted station of the Imams while explicitly denying Prophethood for them, preserving the distinction between Imamate and nubuwwah.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Abdullah Bin Bahr, from Ibn Muskan, from Abdul Rahman Bin Abu Abdullah, from Muhammad Bin Muslim who said,

‘The Imams<sup>asws</sup> are at the status of Rasool-Allah<sup>as</sup> except that they<sup>asws</sup> aren’t with the Prophet-hood, nor is it Permissible for them<sup>asws</sup> from the women what was Permissible for the Prophet<sup>saww</sup>. So, as for whatever is besides that, so they<sup>asws</sup> with regards to it are at the status of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 7. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from ‘Abdallah ibn Bahr from ibn Muskan from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn abu ‘Abdallah from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said that he heard abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) say the following.

“The Imams (a.s.) possess the position of the Messenger of Allah except that they are not prophets and the number of wives permissible for the Holy Prophet is not permissible for them. In the aspects other than these they possess the same positions as the Messenger of Allah did.”
